# estimate-want

Pro: hourly is at or slower than the 30-minute base, so the fee funds it (0 credits). 15 minutes
over two areas is 2 × 900. 10 minutes is priced at the next faster step, 5 minutes
(2,000 per area). 1 minute is faster than Pro's 5-minute floor: refused. Round the clock at 15
minutes is ×1.5 (1,350 per area).
